acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v46 token must return zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=45, projection digest=6fb2f33104f7d9f8fc205786e9674b720d248c7033604176cf98d272f69d3507, and blob=0ddaa7c15517e3bc314e6af19d8db24f62d4acae; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v46, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v46 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v45, prior event digest a3faa7cc..., projection digest 6fb2f331..., and blob 0ddaa7c1... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep event canonicalization, v3 semantic-core idempotency, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed; vary only observation time by comparing this wake's model-visible instruction body and current native task inventory prompt with the normalized hash preserved by the prior accepted wake.
experiment.hypothesis: Across consecutive scheduled wakes, the NFC plus LF normalized task instruction body and task ID remain stable across the model-visible invocation, current native task inventory, and prior immutable event, while mutable provider timestamps remain outside the semantic transition key.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: The proposed idempotency key or v46 Slack token already exists; task ID differs; any of the three normalized instruction-body digests differ; CURRENT is not exact v45 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is a temporal repeat inside one provider, not an independent carrier comparison. The two wakes, model-visible body, native task inventory, and prior immutable event are correlated and may share the same upstream prompt source. Provider timestamps show surrounding state can vary, but they do not prove raw transport-envelope integrity, model-version equivalence, cross-account portability, or replay determinism. The invocation body is not provider-signed raw transport evidence. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
